mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines 12-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of months with UNRATE > 0.3pp rise, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate housing sector contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where RSAFS and HOUST both decline, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 2.0% year-over-year signals robust supply chain efficiency that lowers inflation expectations and reduces monetary policy tightening risk, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods with INDPRO growth > 2.0% YoY, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls growth exceeding 200,000 per month indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of months with PAYEMS > 200k, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of months with CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real GDP (GDPC1) and residential investment (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand weakness that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances where GDPC1 and RSAFS both decline, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tight labor market that generates wage pressures and inflation expectations, triggering monetary policy tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods with UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
